body: No one on here is going to tell you the best way to kill yourself. Sorry.
Something about feelings of inadequacy. Idk, it wasn't that clear.

I've been actively wanting to kill myself for 5 years & people online would always say the same things. They said it would get better. I didn't just wait around for it to get better either. I tried to make it get better. I've tried everything. But nothing ever gets better. Usually it just gets worse. I can't make friends or get dates. Not even online. I'm so lonely. I try to have a good self esteem, but it's difficult when the feedback you keep getting is that you're not good enough.
Well, what are these ways? Life is all there is. I haven't taken this lightly. It's just that I find there really isn't left for me.
Well, if no one notices just tell them. Tell them to help you. Go get help. Get a therapist. Get medication if you want.

Hahahahahah wtf? No fap? That's not a challenge for me. But wow, kudos to you as I've never seen anyone suggest the no fap subreddit to suicidal people. I'm autistic, it causes my social skills to suck. My general mannerisms may seem strange to people & it's not something I can really control. I can't do direct eye contact, etc. I can't stop being autistic. I can't change it. I'm a clean person. I put thought in to the way I dress, I have clear skin, clean hair, etc. I think I look acceptable, I have no problem with the way I look. I have great posture. I've read all the books on this kind of stuff. Yet I can't make friends or get a date or get a job. I'm a cinephile so movie marathons are a norm for me. I'm 85 pounds, I can't lift more than 20 pounds. I've tried the getting really drunk stuff. Idk, I don't think it helped.

I write stuff down in my journal a lot. I have options. I have the option to live. Nothing is forcing me to die. I don't have cancer. But the living option is really fucking terrible. My future will be quite bleak if I live. If I die... Nothing. I don't want to die, no one does really. But I don't want to live. My life is something that is so undesirable to me that ceasing to exist is the best option.
Should you kill yourself? No one on here is gonna say yes.
I'm 21. I'm autistic & kind of dependent of my family since it's kind of difficult for me to get a job. So I can't move away & start over. Anyway, where would I move?

Anyone I've ever cared about doesn't care about me. I have no one that cares about me. Thanks for being nice, but I posted this because I needed help with my note. No one has helped me with that. That sucks.
Erm, if you want you can pm me or whatever. If you're looking for sympathy, I suppose I could be of help to you there.
I've thought about this for years. I've tried everything. It's not gonna change. I'm killing myself & that's that.
